description: This file contains an abstract test class for publisher actors in a messaging system, including setup, teardown, and various test methods to verify message publishing, acknowledgments, and responses in an Akka actor system context.

classes.name: AbstractPublisherActorTest
classes.description: An abstract JUnit test class for testing publisher actors within the Eclipse Ditto messaging system using Akka actors and testkit. It provides setup, teardown, utility methods, and abstract hooks for subclasses to implement specific behaviors and verifications.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the actor system before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: testPublishMessage
methods.description: Tests the publishing of a message via the publisher actor.

methods.name: testAutoAck
methods.description: Tests the automatic acknowledgment feature during message publishing.

methods.name: testPublishResponseToReplyTarget
methods.description: Tests handling of message responses directed to a reply target.

methods.name: createTestTarget
methods.description: Creates a target object configured for testing, with acknowledgment headers.

methods.name: getOutboundAddress
methods.description: Abstract method to get the outbound address; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Abstract method to set up mocks for testing; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain actor Props for the publisher actor.

methods.name: publisherCreated
methods.description: Hook called after publisher actor creation; can be overridden for custom behavior.

methods.name: decorateTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to decorate or modify a Target object.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to verify that a message was published correctly.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to verify message publication to a reply target.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Abstract method to verify acknowledgment handling.

methods.name: getMockOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates a mock outbound signal with optional additional headers.

methods.name: getMockOutboundSignalWithAutoAck
methods.description: Creates a mock outbound signal configured for auto acknowledgment.

methods.name: getResponseWithReplyTarget
methods.description: Creates a mock outbound signal response configured for reply target messaging.
